title: Thadrak Kanjur 'Bum Ca
shelf_note: A manuscript Kanjur volume of the Śatasāhasrikā Prajñāpāramitā ('Bum), handwritten pothi leaves. It belongs on the Tibetan shelf.
structure_note: Each photograph holds two pothi leaves (I5), and the run is not in reading order. Text runs 524-top → 524-bottom → 525-top (ending 'དེ་ནས་བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་ཀྱིས།') → 526-top ('ལྷའི་དབང་པོ་བརྒྱ་བྱིན་ལ་བཀའ་སྩལ་པ', ending '…ཐོབ་པར') → 525-bottom ('གྱུར་པ་དང་།…') → 526-bottom. The bottom leaf of 525 and the top leaf of 526 are swapped in reading order, so a reader hits a non sequitur at 525. The run has no printed numbers, and 439 of 556 pages are translated.
